ops.title: v14 docs rendering: static griffe over _native.pyi; facades must re-export via imports
ops.body:
The docs reference for cc-transcript's native classes renders through STATIC griffe analysis of the generated `cc_transcript/_native.pyi` — never dynamic introspection. great-docs' dynamic-mode probe is permanently off for this package: the union aliases (`TranscriptEvent`, `ContentBlock`, `ToolCall`, …) are `types.UnionType` instances with no `__module__`, the dynamic loader aliases them to themselves, and the resulting CyclicAliasError flips the whole reference to static mode.

Two invariants follow (both broken silently if regressed — the build stays green while every native class page degrades to a bare `X = _native.X` line):

1. Facade re-exports of native classes (models.py, tools.py) must be IMPORTS (`from cc_transcript._native import X as X`), never assignments (`X = _native.X`) — static griffe only creates resolvable aliases from imports.
2. Every `#[pyclass]` must claim a real facade module string (`module = "cc_transcript.models"` etc.), never the package root — a root-module claim makes the root re-export alias resolve to itself (cyclic), which is what disabled dynamic mode for Transcript/EventList until fixed (commit "fix(views): Transcript and EventList claim the models facade module").

Spot-check after touching this machinery: `great_docs._renderer.introspection.get_object("cc_transcript:UserEvent")` must yield kind=class with members, and the rendered `_site/reference/UserEvent.html` must show properties + Google sections, not an assignment line.
